stem: Based on the facts of this case and your knowledge of constitutional rights, which outcome resulted from this U.S. Supreme Court decision?

options.label: A
options.text: Constitutional guarantees of due process in criminal trials were increased.

options.label: B
options.text: Constitutional protections against unlawful searches and seizures were expanded.

options.label: C
options.text: Constitutional assurances of the right to an attorney were expanded.

options.label: D
options.text: Constitutional safeguards against excessive bails and fines were increased.

visual_elements:
This list highlights some facts from a U.S. Supreme Court case during the 1960s.

Mapp v. Ohio (1961)

• Police officers forcibly entered a house without a warrant.
• Officers arrested house owner Dollree Mapp for having illegal photographs.
• Mapp appealed to the Supreme Court, saying that her constitutional liberties had been violated.
• The Supreme Court decided in favor of Mapp.
